firing.source: var Hello = createReactClass({ render: function() { return null; } });

findings.message: This component is built with the `createReactClass` factory, which React removed from the library and now ships as a separate package nobody maintains. It carries its own version of features the language has since grown, notably automatic binding of methods to the instance, so a reader who knows classes cannot predict what `this` is here. Write it as a class extending `React.Component` instead.
